content:
One important correction: `s3.aws.upbound.io` is the Upbound/Crossplane AWS provider API, not an ACK API. Native ACK S3 resources use `s3.services.k8s.aws`. The manifests below follow the explicitly requested `s3.aws.upbound.io` API and use matching Upbound IAM resources.

Assuming the existing AWS `ProviderConfig` is named `default`, add the following structure:

```text
infra/logs/
├── base/
│   ├── bucket.yaml
│   ├── iam.yaml
│   ├── kustomization.yaml
│   └── serviceaccount.yaml
└── overlays/
    ├── dev/
    │   ├── kustomization.yaml
    │   └── patches.yaml
    └── prod/
        ├── kustomization.yaml
        └── patches.yaml
flux/
└── kustomizations.yaml
```

### `infra/logs/base/kustomization.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization

namespace: myapp

resources:
  - bucket.yaml
  - iam.yaml
  - serviceaccount.yaml
```

### `infra/logs/base/bucket.yaml`

The split resources are the idiomatic form for current Upbound S3 CRDs.

```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: myapp
    app.kubernetes.io/component: logs
spec:
  forProvider:
    region: REGION
    tags:
      Application: myapp
      Component: logs
      Environment: ENVIRONMENT
  providerConfigRef:
    name: default
---
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: BucketVersioning
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
spec:
  forProvider:
    region: REGION
    bucketRef:
      name: myapp-logs
    versioningConfiguration:
      - status: Enabled
  providerConfigRef:
    name: default
---
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: BucketServerSideEncryptionConfiguration
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
spec:
  forProvider:
    region: REGION
    bucketRef:
      name: myapp-logs
    rule:
      - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
          - sseAlgorithm: AES256
  providerConfigRef:
    name: default
---
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: BucketPublicAccessBlock
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
spec:
  forProvider:
    region: REGION
    bucketRef:
      name: myapp-logs
    blockPublicAcls: true
    blockPublicPolicy: true
    ignorePublicAcls: true
    restrictPublicBuckets: true
  providerConfigRef:
    name: default
```

### `infra/logs/base/iam.yaml`

The policy has no wildcard actions. The object resource ends in `/*` because S3 object permissions must cover objects beneath the bucket.

```yaml
apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: myapp
    app.kubernetes.io/component: logs
spec:
  forProvider:
    assumeRolePolicy: |
      {
        "Version": "2012-10-17",
        "Statement": [
          {
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Principal": {
              "Federated": "OIDC_PROVIDER_ARN"
            },
            "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
            "Condition": {
              "StringEquals": {
                "OIDC_ISSUER:aud": "sts.amazonaws.com",
                "OIDC_ISSUER:sub": "system:serviceaccount:myapp:myapp-logs"
              }
            }
          }
        ]
      }
    tags:
      Application: myapp
      Component: logs
      Environment: ENVIRONMENT
  providerConfigRef:
    name: default
---
apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: Policy
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: myapp
    app.kubernetes.io/component: logs
spec:
  forProvider:
    policy: |
      {
        "Version": "2012-10-17",
        "Statement": [
          {
            "Sid": "ListBucket",
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Action": [
              "s3:GetBucketLocation",
              "s3:ListBucket",
              "s3:ListBucketMultipartUploads"
            ],
            "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::BUCKET_NAME"
          },
          {
            "Sid": "ReadWriteObjects",
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Action": [
              "s3:AbortMultipartUpload",
              "s3:DeleteObject",
              "s3:GetObject",
              "s3:GetObjectVersion",
              "s3:ListMultipartUploadParts",
              "s3:PutObject"
            ],
            "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::BUCKET_NAME/*"
          }
        ]
      }
    tags:
      Application: myapp
      Component: logs
      Environment: ENVIRONMENT
  providerConfigRef:
    name: default
---
apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: RolePolicyAttachment
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: myapp
    app.kubernetes.io/component: logs
spec:
  forProvider:
    policyArnRef:
      name: myapp-logs
    roleRef:
      name: myapp-logs
  providerConfigRef:
    name: default
```

### `infra/logs/base/serviceaccount.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
  annotations:
    eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn: ROLE_ARN
```

## Dev overlay

The OIDC issuer must omit the `https://` prefix inside the IAM condition key.

### `infra/logs/overlays/dev/kustomization.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization

resources:
  - ../../base

patches:
  - path: patches.yaml
```

### `infra/logs/overlays/dev/patches.yaml`

Replace the account ID, OIDC provider ID, and region with the existing dev cluster values.

```yaml

kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
spec:
  forProvider:
    region: us-east-1
    tags:
      Environment: dev
---
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: BucketVersioning
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
spec:
  forProvider:
    region: us-east-1
---
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: BucketServerSideEncryptionConfiguration
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
spec:
  forProvider:
    region: us-east-1
---
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: BucketPublicAccessBlock
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
spec:
  forProvider:
    region: us-east-1
---
apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
spec:
  forProvider:
    assumeRolePolicy: |
      {
        "Version": "2012-10-17",
        "Statement": [
          {
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Principal": {
              "Federated": "arn:aws:iam::DEV_ACCOUNT_ID:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/DEV_OIDC_ID"
            },
            "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
            "Condition": {
              "StringEquals": {
                "oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/DEV_OIDC_ID:aud": "sts.amazonaws.com",
                "oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/DEV_OIDC_ID:sub": "system:serviceaccount:myapp:myapp-logs"
              }
            }
          }
        ]
      }
    tags:
      Environment: dev
---
apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: Policy
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
spec:
  forProvider:
    policy: |
      {
        "Version": "2012-10-17",
        "Statement": [
          {
            "Sid": "ListBucket",
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Action": [
              "s3:GetBucketLocation",
              "s3:ListBucket",
              "s3:ListBucketMultipartUploads"
            ],
            "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-dev"
          },
          {
            "Sid": "ReadWriteObjects",
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Action": [
              "s3:AbortMultipartUpload",
              "s3:DeleteObject",
              "s3:GetObject",
              "s3:GetObjectVersion",
              "s3:ListMultipartUploadParts",
              "s3:PutObject"
            ],
            "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-dev/*"
          }
        ]
      }
    tags:
      Environment: dev
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
  annotations:
    eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn: arn:aws:iam::DEV_ACCOUNT_ID:role/myapp-logs-dev
```

The resource names also need environment-specific external names. Add these transformations to the dev `kustomization.yaml`:

```yaml
nameSuffix: -dev
```

Because `nameSuffix` also changes the ServiceAccount name, override it in the IRSA trust subject if using this approach:

```text
system:serviceaccount:myapp:myapp-logs-dev
```

and use that ServiceAccount in the workload. The complete dev kustomization therefore becomes:

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization

resources:
  - ../../base

nameSuffix: -dev

patches:
  - path: patches.yaml
```

Update the patch targets from `myapp-logs` to their pre-transform base name as shown; Kustomize applies the suffix after matching.

## Flux kustomizations

Add separate reconciliation objects to `flux/kustomizations.yaml`. The `sourceRef` must match the repository’s existing `GitRepository`; `flux-system` is the common bootstrap name.

```yaml
---
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: logs-dev
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 10m
  retryInterval: 1m
  timeout: 5m
  path: ./infra/logs/overlays/dev
  prune: true
  wait: true
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: flux-system
  dependsOn:
    - name: infrastructure-dev
---
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: logs-prod
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 10m
  retryInterval: 1m
  timeout: 5m
  path: ./infra/logs/overlays/prod
  prune: true
  wait: true
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: flux-system
  dependsOn:
    - name: infrastructure-prod
```

Adjust the `dependsOn` names to the existing provider/CRD kustomizations, or remove them if the repository does not use those names.

No SOPS file is needed here: bucket names, AWS account IDs, OIDC provider URLs, and role ARNs are identifiers rather than secrets. Provider credentials, if Git-managed, must remain in the repository’s existing SOPS-encrypted secret.
